outcomes.rule: Before releasing native changes, compile the affected translation units with the production Windows/MSVC headers; portable policy tests alone do not cover Windows macros.
outcomes.check: production-header MSVC syntax/build check, including new identifiers

outcomes.rule: For raid AI changes, require an isolated running-world scenario that observes the intended effect with competing stock strategies enabled. An action returning success or a policy test is not proof of healing, aura acquisition, or safe movement.
outcomes.check: dojo raid acceptance receipt for the candidate native build (pending runtime gate)

outcomes.attribution_note: The public fix documents the live failure, but does not identify one introducing PR. Do not infer a reviewer from the fix author.
